title: Challenge-TV
wikitext:
''Challenge-TV'' was a site that holds [[demo|demos]] for various games, but mainly [[QW]] and CPMA.

''CHTV'' was started in [[2000]] by [[Dethkultur]], [[Hoony]], [[DonKing]] and [[Agent (American Player)|Agent]]. Prior to Challenge=TV, "Stayne's Demos" was a very popular repository run by Peter Stayne out of his parent's home, on a home cable internet connection. When finally shut down by the cable company, Stayne offered the repository of around 10,000 demos to start Challenge-TV. It is currently maintained and scheduled for a site-wide overhaul by [[DonKing]] and [[Putty]]. A lot of hard work and dedication has made CHTV the #1 source for game recordings. CHTV has over 22,000 demos!

www.challenge-tv.com (original website - defunct)

[[Lolek]]'s backup: https://quake1.pl/demos/chtv_demos/
